paper_title: Overview of the Cosmic Axion Spin Precession Experiment (CASPEr)
notes: Overview/proposal paper presenting projected sensitivities for CASPEr Electric (axion-induced oscillating nuclear EDM via gd, gluon coupling) and CASPEr Wind (gaNN nucleon coupling). The CASPEr Electric reach plot (Fig. 3) is on the gd / EDM coupling plane, while CASPEr Wind (Fig. 4) is on the gaNN nucleon coupling plane. These are projections, not measured limits. No numerical data points are given in tables or text—only figures with shaded projection regions. Local DM density assumed rho_DM ≈ 0.4 GeV/cm^3. Coupling type ambiguous between AxionEDM (gd) and AxionNeutron (gaNN) since the paper covers both; AxionEDM chosen per hint and the prominent CASPEr Electric reach figure, hence reduced confidence.
